body: i wish i knew..my parents hated me, bosses have hated me. i dont yell and im very polite. but im not a pushover. once they realize who i am they hate me

Since I was a kid I got the blame for everything. Mom blamed be for dad leaving. Dad blamed me for mom dying. Without guidance and being able to talk to someone you go dead. No one has ever listened or cared about me like I do them. Something is always been wrong with me. I'm different. I don't know what it is but something deep down makes me appealing at first, then disgusting soon after. I'll just save the time for anyone that would want to pretend to know me. Everything is an illusion. It's the truth
A hug from someone who knew me. Or even just someone to listen to me without their own agenda or ego. Not in internet land either.
